role: Predeclared expanded development protocol comparison; not independent matched-population FAR acceptance
decision: Reject v33 replacing v30; masking all16 unverified prefix slots reduced proxy hits and retained premature triggers. Preserve v30 model and threshold.
interpretation: Does not prove every prefix label correct, nor rule out selectively verified prefix masking. Compared end-to-end training recipes with unchanged architecture and v33 input-sampling policy; original export representative tensors were not recorded for exact equality.
next_research: Do not repeat global prefix removal/masking. Investigate auxiliary phrase supervision only with an explicit valid-window or clip-aggregation protocol, or independently audit training pronunciation. Missing phone references still block ultimate latency/recall acceptance.
